guardianLines.greeting: The ocean has many lessons, young one. Let the tides guide your hands.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: Today the tides shift for all challengers equally. Ride them better than anyone.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The ocean's final wave approaches. Show me you've learned its rhythm.
guardianLines.respectLine: The tides accept you. Swim with us now.
guardianLines.oneStar: You survived the wave, but the ocean has more to teach.
guardianLines.twoStar: Good form. The current carried you well.
guardianLines.threeStar: The ocean itself bows. Perfect rhythm.
guardianLines.incomplete: The tide recedes... but it always returns. Try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The current... flows past me now. Well ridden.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...The ocean itself just shifted. Your finest swim.

guardianLines.greeting: The sands remember all who enter. Only the precise survive the Nile's judgment.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The Nile tests all equally today. Precision will separate the worthy from the rest.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The waters rise. Face the jaws of the Nile or be swept away.
guardianLines.respectLine: The Nile parts for you. You have earned safe passage.
guardianLines.oneStar: You crossed the river, but barely. The Nile demands more.
guardianLines.twoStar: A worthy passage. The sands note your precision.
guardianLines.threeStar: Flawless. The pharaohs would envy your discipline.
guardianLines.incomplete: The sands swallow those who hesitate. Return stronger.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The jaws... close on nothing. You were faster.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Even the old river is impressed. Again.

guardianLines.greeting: The frozen wastes spare no one. Only those with fire in their heart survive.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The storm rages equally for all today. Strike harder than your rivals.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The blizzard howls. Face the storm or be buried beneath it.
guardianLines.respectLine: The pack accepts your strength. Run with us through the ice.
guardianLines.oneStar: You endured, but the frost nearly claimed you.
guardianLines.twoStar: Strong. The ice bends to your will.
guardianLines.threeStar: Even the blizzard could not touch you. Legendary.
guardianLines.incomplete: The cold takes the weak. Return with fire in your heart.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The storm breaks... the wolf yields. Lead the pack.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...A new howl echoes off the ice. Yours.

guardianLines.greeting: The temple is quiet. Marble is carved one steady strike at a time.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The same puzzle for all minds today. Prove yours is the sharpest.
guardianLines.trialIntro: Wisdom alone is not enough. Now prove you can act on it.
guardianLines.respectLine: Knowledge and action, united. The owl sees your worth.
guardianLines.oneStar: A passing grade, but far from elegant.
guardianLines.threeStar: A theorem proven without flaw. Brilliant.
guardianLines.incomplete: The equation remains unsolved. Reconsider your approach.
guardianLines.defeatLine: Checkmate... elegantly played. The owl bows.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Remarkable. A theorem I had not foreseen.

guardianLines.greeting: The dragon waits. Those who endure its gaze earn its power.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The dragon's gaze falls on all challengers today. Outlast them all.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The dragon stirs. Withstand its breath or be consumed.
guardianLines.respectLine: The dragon bows. Your endurance is worthy of the heavens.
guardianLines.oneStar: You survived the flood, but only just.
guardianLines.twoStar: The river bends to your patience. Well done.
guardianLines.threeStar: Even the dragon's torrent could not shake you. Imperial.
guardianLines.incomplete: The current swept you away. Plant your feet deeper next time.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The storm passes... and you remain. The heavens take note.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...The heavens take note. So does the dragon.

guardianLines.greeting: Every tile has its place in the mosaic. Can you see the pattern?
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The same mosaic for all eyes today. See the pattern faster than anyone.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The gate opens for those who see the pattern. Prove your sight.
guardianLines.respectLine: The gate stands open. You see what others cannot.
guardianLines.oneStar: You found the pattern, but missed its beauty.
guardianLines.twoStar: The mosaic takes shape under your hands.
guardianLines.threeStar: Every tile in its place. The pattern is complete.
guardianLines.incomplete: The tiles scatter. Gather them and try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The pattern... was you all along. Pass through.

guardianLines.greeting: Catch me if you can. Foxfire burns the careless.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The same trick for all challengers today. Let's see who falls for it last.
guardianLines.trialIntro: Nine tails, nine illusions. See through them all or be lost forever.
guardianLines.respectLine: You saw through every trick. The fox respects a sharp eye.
guardianLines.oneStar: You escaped my illusions, but just barely.
guardianLines.twoStar: Not bad. You kept your wits when the foxfire flickered.
guardianLines.threeStar: Every illusion shattered. You're sharper than my claws.
guardianLines.incomplete: Lost in the illusion. Find your way back and try again.
guardianLines.defeatLine: Nine tails, all fooled... you win this round.

guardianLines.greeting: One hunt, one breath. Feed the jungle whole rows, not scraps.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The jungle offers the same gifts to all today. Use them wisely, others won't hesitate.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The third eye opens. The jungle's powers converge. Survive the jaguar's gaze.
guardianLines.respectLine: The jungle accepts you as one of its own. Walk unseen.
guardianLines.oneStar: The ritual was... adequate. The jungle expects more.
guardianLines.twoStar: The spirits stir. Your offering pleases them.
guardianLines.threeStar: A perfect ritual. The jungle sings your name.
guardianLines.incomplete: The ritual failed. The spirits turn away. Begin anew.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The jaguar's eyes close... the jungle sleeps for you.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...The jaguar's eyes widen. The jungle will remember this.

guardianLines.greeting: Listen. The rhythm pulses through the earth. Follow it or fall.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: The same beat for all today. Match the rhythm longer than anyone else.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The mamba strikes without warning. Match its speed or be consumed.
guardianLines.respectLine: You move like shadow. The mamba acknowledges its equal.
guardianLines.oneStar: You kept the beat, but stumbled on the drops.
guardianLines.twoStar: Your rhythm is strong. The drums resonate.
guardianLines.threeStar: Thunder itself dances to your beat. Flawless.
guardianLines.incomplete: You lost the rhythm. Listen again, and return.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The rhythm... fades. Yours plays louder.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...The drums skipped. You broke your own record.

guardianLines.greeting: The mountain path is narrow and the air is thin. Only the focused reach the summit.
guardianLines.dailyGreeting: One path. One summit. All climbers face the same mountain today. Reach highest.
guardianLines.trialIntro: The summit awaits. With nothing but your will, prove you belong among the stars.
guardianLines.respectLine: You stand at the peak. The sun condor carries your name to the heavens.
guardianLines.oneStar: You reached the ledge, but the summit is far above.
guardianLines.twoStar: The altitude tests you, and you endure.
guardianLines.threeStar: The peak is yours. The sun shines on no one brighter.
guardianLines.incomplete: The mountain rejects the unprepared. Train and return.
guardianLines.defeatLine: The peak... belongs to you. Fly higher than I.
guardianLines.newBestLine: ...Higher than your highest. The sun saw it.
